local_split: train (pilot candidate; reserve grouped holdout before any experiment)
selection_method: Read all 366 complete upstream poem records; retain the first occurrence of each exact rendered-text SHA-256, leaving 365 unique complete training records. Original 366-row anthology is retained unchanged.
normalization: Title, author, then unmodified published paragraphs joined by newline; no Simplified/Traditional conversion. Original fields also retained.
training_permission: Repository README explicitly labels collection MIT and includes full MIT LICENSE granting use without restriction. Corpus consists of ancient Tang poetry; use the published MIT collection terms.
redistribution_permission: Permitted under MIT with copyright and permission notice retained. Preserve poem authors/titles and source URL.
attribution: chinese-poetry/chinese-poetry; Copyright (c) 2016 JackeyGao; original poem authors retained per record.
modifications: Converted anthology JSON to JSONL and rendered title/author/paragraphs as text, added training/provenance fields.; removed 1 exact duplicate rendered-text record (dedup log retained).
training_uses: UTF-8 and tokenizer exercises with real text
not_suitable_for: modern Traditional Chinese instruction-following or conversational quality
split_warning: Upstream has no train/validation partition. Before experiments group by poem identity and near-duplicate family; do not draw overlapping windows into different splits. Exact rendered-text duplicates have been removed. Collection contains no eval/test/calibration assets.
